nodes.title: String OutputList / 12 Lifestyle Prompt
widgets_values:
Make this person at a crosswalk in a beige raincoat, captured in a detailed medium close-up from a low side angle with a 35mm lens at f/2.8, her profile filling the frame against blurred neon reflections on wet pavement, expression calm and focused.
Make this person sit on concrete steps in a blue denim jacket and black skirt, leaning back on her elbows with one knee raised, framed from the chest up in a tight shot. View from a slightly high angle using a 50mm lens at f/2.2, smiling faintly, face prominent in the frame.
Make this person lean against a café window in a light grey hoodie and dark jeans, framed in a close-up. Viewed from a dutch angle at chest height with a 35mm lens at f/2.0, expression thoughtful, face dominating the view.
Make this person sit cross-legged on a wooden floor in an oversized cream sweater, photographed from directly above in a tight medium-close shot focusing on her face and head. Use a 24mm lens at f/4.0, her expression calm and contemplative.
Make this person recline sideways across a sofa in a red silk dress, captured from a low front angle at eye level. This is an intimate close-up focusing sharply on her face, expression dreamy with a faint smile, shot with an 85mm lens at f/1.8.
Make this person stand in profile against a plain white wall, framed in a tight bust shot wearing a black business suit, hands tucked into her pockets. Shot with a 50mm lens at f/2.5 from a side angle, expression serious and composed, face prominent.
Make this person sit at an outdoor café table in a yellow sundress,  leaning forward with both elbows on the surface, toward the camera. A medium close-up viewed from a tilted dutch angle with a 35mm lens at f/2.2, smiling warmly, her face filling the upper portion of the frame.
Make this person walking barefoot along the shoreline in a white flowing skirt and pastel blue tank top. A low ground angle shot focused upwards, framing her face and shoulders prominently against the sky. Her expression turned upward with a soft smile, captured with a 24mm lens at f/4.0.
Make this person crouch near a city fountain at night, wearing a black leather jacket and dark jeans, hands resting on her knees. This is a tight medium shot captured from slightly above with a wide 28mm lens at f/3.2, her playful and laughing expression filling the center frame.
Make this person stand on a rooftop edge in an oversized olive-green coat. Framed as a tight profile close-up from a dramatic low side angle, face prominent against the urban background, shot with a 35mm lens at f/2.8, expression serious with a distant gaze.
Make this person sit on the floor against a blank wall wearing grey workout leggings and a white tank top, knees pulled close to her chest. A close-up photographed from a high angle with a 50mm lens at f/2.0, focusing tightly on her face, expression tired but calm
Make this person stand in an art gallery, wearing a dark green fitted dress, leaning slightly with arms crossed. Captured in a tight medium shot from a slightly high diagonal angle with a 35mm lens at f/2.5, her contemplative face framed centrally.
